name: Solenne Atelier ThermaVeil Smart-Lined Winter Coat
description: A structured, knee-length coat in deep obsidian with phase-change smart fabric lining that actively modulates heat output based on skin temperature readings pulled from a paired BCI. The exterior is a liquid-resistant wool-cashmere analog with hand-stitched lapels; interior seams glow faintly amber when the thermal system is active. Fits are made-to-measure, accommodating any aug or geneware configuration.
functionality: BCI-synced phase-change lining auto-adjusts thermal output across the coat's surface; custom-fitted to wearer's exact aug and geneware profile at point of manufacture.
what_it_says: Old money or new power — either way, this coat costs more than a Tier 2 worker's annual wage and it shows in every thread.
story_hooks: The BCI sync contains a passive data-collection routine — Solenne Atelier harvests biometric data from every coat in the field; someone just noticed.
A Spire executive left this coat in a Tier 2 transit locker three weeks ago — whoever finds the claim token owns something worth more than the locker's entire building.

physical_description.visual_profile: A commanding, tailored silhouette that reads haute couture even in neo-noir context—sharp lapels frame the chest, structured shoulders create angular presence. The coat commands attention without ostentation, suggesting wealth through restraint and precision engineering.
physical_description.fit: Bespoke, made-to-measure accommodation; cuts cleanly to the knee with no excess fabric. Tailored through the torso and shoulders, with articulated seams that allow freedom for augmented limbs without bunching or gaps.
physical_description.primary_material: Liquid-resistant wool-cashmere analog exterior (synth-blend maintaining natural drape); phase-change smart fabric interior lining with embedded thermal regulation threads
physical_description.texture: Exterior: smooth with subtle nap, feels substantial and warm to touch. Interior: faintly textured thermal weave with barely-perceptible grid pattern from embedded sensor nodes. Hand-stitched lapels show micro-irregularities that signal artisanal quality.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep obsidian black (near-black, near-absolute) as primary; interior seams emit faint amber glow when thermal system engages; subtle silver threading at buttonholes and edge-binding
physical_description.closures: Hand-matched obsidian-tone buttons (likely mother-of-pearl or high-grade synth-ceramic) down center front; magnetic micro-snaps at cuff and hem for seamless closure around augmented wrists/ankles
distinctive_features: Phase-change thermal lining powered by paired BCI interface
Interior seams glow amber under active thermal regulation
Invisible sensor grid embedded in lining for continuous temperature monitoring
Seam-integrated fiber optics along interior edges
Articulated cut to accommodate any augmentation configuration without tailoring gaps
Liquid-resistant outer shell (spill/rain resistant, not waterproof)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1 luxury—handmade, bespoke, BCI-integrated, Spire District provenance, price point likely Φ8,000+
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals corpo elite or high-end independent contractor. Wearer prioritizes cutting-edge biotech integration with aesthetic refinement. Suggests stability, discretionary wealth, and comfort with visible body modification.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when acquired; breaks in beautifully with age, developing subtle creases that enhance tailored silhouette. Unlikely to show wear given material durability and wearer's socioeconomic tier.
